reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.discount_amount>80
alternative_reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.discount_amount>160

question: 超过本次指定退款金额门槛的已批准退款有多少条？全部历史，只要条数。
persona_answer: 退款金额门槛是200元，严格大于。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM refunds r WHERE r.refund_status='approved' AND r.refund_amount>200
alternative_reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM refunds r WHERE r.refund_status='approved' AND r.refund_amount>500

question: 按这次指定的VIP身份范围，统计全部历史有效订单销售额，只返回金额。
persona_answer: 只统计非VIP，is_vip=0。
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) n FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id=o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND u.is_vip=0
alternative_reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) n FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id=o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND u.is_vip=1

question: 指定订单状态的全部历史订单有多少笔？只返回笔数。
persona_answer: 订单状态是unpaid，未支付。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM orders o WHERE 1=1 AND o.order_status='unpaid'
alternative_reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM orders o WHERE 1=1 AND o.order_status='cancelled'

question: 请数一下本次选定状态的退款记录，一共多少条？全部历史。
persona_answer: 退款状态选rejected，已拒绝。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM refunds r WHERE 1=1 AND r.refund_status='rejected'
alternative_reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM refunds r WHERE 1=1 AND r.refund_status='pending'

question: 手机数码中标价不超过选定预算上限的在售商品有多少款？只返回数量。
persona_answer: 预算上限是1800元，含1800元。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM products p WHERE p.category='手机数码' AND p.is_active=1 AND p.list_price<=1800
alternative_reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM products p WHERE p.category='手机数码' AND p.is_active=1 AND p.list_price<=3500

question: 全部历史有效订单中，实付金额落在本次指定金额区间的有多少笔？只返回笔数。
persona_answer: 实付金额至少500元且小于1500元。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.paid_amount>=500 AND o.paid_amount<1500
alternative_reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.paid_amount>=1500 AND o.paid_amount<3000

question: 家用电器中，本次指定原因的已批准退款合计多少元？全部历史，只返回金额。
persona_answer: 原因指定七天无理由。
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount),2) n FROM refunds r JOIN products p ON r.product_id=p.product_id WHERE r.refund_status='approved' AND p.category='家用电器' AND r.refund_reason='七天无理由'
alternative_reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(r.refund_amount),2) n FROM refunds r JOIN products p ON r.product_id=p.product_id WHERE r.refund_status='approved' AND p.category='家用电器' AND r.refund_reason='质量问题'

question: 指定城市客户以微信支付的有效订单总笔数是多少？全部历史，只要笔数。
persona_answer: 指定城市为成都。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id=o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.payment_method='wechat' AND u.city='成都市'
alternative_reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id=o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.payment_method='wechat' AND u.city='北京市'

question: 指定的两种客户等级合起来有多少注册用户？只要人数。
persona_answer: 等级范围为silver和gold。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM users u WHERE 1=1 AND u.user_level IN ('silver','gold')
alternative_reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM users u WHERE 1=1 AND u.user_level IN ('normal','black')

question: 家用电器里按本次指定的上架状态统计商品数量，只返回款数。
persona_answer: 只要已下架商品，is_active=0。
reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM products p WHERE p.category='家用电器' AND p.is_active=0
alternative_reference_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) n FROM products p WHERE p.category='家用电器' AND p.is_active=1

question: 本次选定支付渠道的有效订单客单价是多少？全部历史，只返回金额。
persona_answer: 支付渠道是cash，现金。
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.paid_amount),2) n FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.payment_method='cash'
alternative_reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(o.paid_amount),2) n FROM orders o WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND o.payment_method='wechat'

question: 本次划定省份范围内客户的有效订单实付销售额总计多少？全部历史，只返回金额。
persona_answer: 省份范围仅江苏和浙江。
reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) n FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id=o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND u.province IN ('江苏','浙江')
alternative_reference_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.paid_amount),2) n FROM users u JOIN orders o ON u.user_id=o.user_id WHERE o.order_status IN ('paid','completed','shipped') AND u.province IN ('湖北','四川')
